description: This file defines the Activity class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling various customer-related activity events such as registration, login, password change, address updates, transactions, and order status changes. It hooks into specific model triggers to log activities for customer actions.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Handles customer activity events such as registration, login, password change, address updates, transactions, and order status updates within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Logs a registration activity when a new customer is added, if customer activity tracking is enabled.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Logs an activity when a customer updates their details.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Logs password change or reset activities depending on whether the customer is logged in or resetting via email.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs a login activity when a customer successfully logs in.

methods.name: forgotten
methods.description: Logs an activity when a customer requests a password reset.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Logs a transaction activity for a customer after a transaction is added.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Logs when a customer adds an affiliate account.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Logs when a customer edits their affiliate information.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Logs when a customer adds a new address.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Logs when a customer edits an existing address.

methods.name: deleteAddress
methods.description: Logs when a customer deletes an address.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Logs when a customer submits a return request, for logged-in or guest customers.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Logs order status changes, particularly when an order moves from no status to a new status.
